draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Parassinikadavu! The Muthappan temple here stands on the banks of the Valapattanam river, and its god is presented through Theyyam, in two forms called Thiruvappan and Vellattam.
draft.hungryLine: My sources don't name eateries here, so ask around near the temple for a simple Kerala meal.

moodReplies.show-me-around: The Muthappan Temple is a 6 min walk, and the Parassinikkadavu Snake Park is about 20 min on foot.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Sit by the Valapattanam river near the temple and watch it slide past.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Vellattam is compared to a temple idol without the prabha-mandalam that circles it. It's the god in its simplest form.

spots.name: Muthappan Temple
spots.detail: 6 min walk · Theyyam for Sree Muthappan by the river

spots.name: Parassinikkadavu Snake Park
spots.detail: 20 min walk · Snake park just off the Kannur-Taliparamba route

legends.title: Shiva in another form
legends.body: According to local tradition, Sree Muthappan is a manifestation of Lord Shiva. The temple belongs to the Thiyya community.

legends.title: Two ways to appear
legends.body: Thiruvappan is the full version of the Theyyam. In Vellattam the ornaments are minimal, so the speech and dance get the most room.

tips.title: Ask about ritual times.
tips.body: Check at the temple when Thiruvappan or Vellattam is being performed that day.

tips.title: Dress modestly at the temple.
tips.body: It's an active place of worship, so cover shoulders and knees.

story.title: A Thiyya temple
story.body: Parassini Madappura Sree Muthappan temple is the Thiyya community's temple on the Valapattanam. Muthappan is worshipped here through Theyyam rather than only an idol.

story.title: A college on the highway
story.body: In October 1986 the Government College of Engineering, Kannur opened at Dharmashala on National Highway 66. Its 75-acre campus is a short trip from here.

story.title: Temple town of Anthoor
story.body: Parassinikadavu is a small town in Anthoor Municipality, about 20 km from Kannur. People come for Muthappan and the snake park.
